Title: Public preview: Simplified provisioning of access to data lake assets

Body.Content:
Simplified provisioning of access to data lake assets is now available in public preview within Azure Purview. Azure Purview already makes it easy for anyone to find data of interest across the enterprise data estate. With this new capability, we are further unlocking the power of Azure Purview’s integration with Azure Storage. Data owners will be able to use a simple intuitive experience to centrally manage access to data in Azure Storage.

Get started.
